purpose: defaults and rules for missing tracker-only data; not a replacement fixture dataset
seed: stable existing match.id plus sport key
adapter_note: Map these keys to actual local sport IDs. Preserve authoritative team/league/logo/time/score/market fields.

missing_scores_policy.scheduled: keep unknown score and show scheduled status
missing_scores_policy.live_or_finished_missing: create one deterministic, sport-and-period-appropriate demo pair in the shared match adapter, not separately in UI components
missing_scores_policy.examples_only: Use current phase/period to choose plausible totals; do not force these scores onto existing valid matches.

football_scene.enabled_when: selected match is LIVE, tracker tab is match, and document is visible
football_scene.disable_motion_when: prefers-reduced-motion; retain a readable static state
football_scene.cleanup: clear interval on match change, hidden tab, non-match tracker tab, status change or unmount
football_scene.phase_label_substitution: Insert actual selected team name for attacking_side.

football_stats_rules: home possession plus away possession equals 100
shots >= shots on target >= goals for each side
counts are non-negative and stable for the match
show home and away labels in addition to color
football_event_rules: derive current period and elapsed time from the same match adapter used by the card
event timestamps do not exceed current elapsed time
goal event totals equal the current home and away score
0-0 may have attempts/corners/cards but no goal events
do not reuse another match player names; omit unprovided player names
additional_market_rules: new demo values are stable by fixture/market/line/outcome key
preserve exact existing numeric precision when formatting
include no-goal outcome for first-scoring-team market
unavailable or closed market obeys existing disabled/action guards

non_football_view.other: derive period/scoring units from existing sport data; do not display soccer pitch
